Proposition C.2 has nine clauses. The closing O(N^{-1}) η-jet sentence is stated only by exists_with_moment_repair_all_jets, for generic data and for its own repair family, which no declaration identifies with v. findings.summary: The closing O(N^-1) η-jet sentence is stated nowhere for the modulated profile of the fixed input profile. Only the generic, never-applied exists_with_moment_repair_all_jets states a rate, and it binds it to its own repair family, not to the Witness.

No single declaration bundles clauses (i)-(viii). They are spread over exists_of_certificate, the Witness structure fields and five namespace lemmas, all for the same v, and conjoin by instantiation and routine algebra alone.
